title: OAC 0.2 Action Profile
description: Published by a tool's author (in MCP: the tool's _meta). Says what the tool does, whether and how it can be undone, its lowest tier, and how every argument is shown: bound to a Preview field, or listed in other_args (shown unchanged). Unsigned; the executor's policy may only raise its tier. Rules beyond the schema: a read declares undo none; no argument is declared twice; occurrence names a declared argument.

binds.description: Preview field -> argument name. Every field a Preview shows must be bound here.

other_args.description: Arguments that are not bound to a field; the Preview shows them unchanged in details. An argument not in binds or other_args is refused.

occurrence.description: The argument whose value identifies the business occurrence (an order id, a booking reference). The executor runs one occurrence at most once and passes the value to the provider as its idempotency key. Required for pay.

occurrence_scope.description: Where occurrence ids are unique, such as one provider account. Tools with the same scope share one record per occurrence, so two tools cannot each run the same order. Defaults to the tool's own name.
